headline: DeepSeek's flash model sets a record 31.2% token share, day 2 and still top of the heap
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 holds the all-time record at 31.2% of tokens, its second day at the top. DeepSeek as a provider now sits at 43.6% and is up 12.5 points over 30 days, so the rest of the leaderboard is playing catch-up.
highlights: DeepSeek's provider share is 43.6% today, and the top five providers together hold 70.4%.
Tencent's tencent/hy4-20261104 debuted at rank 5 with 4.0% of tokens, the biggest new entrant of the day.
Moonshot AI's moonshotai/kimi-k3-20260715 jumped 14 places to rank 10 with 2.0% of tokens.
stealth/crouton-alpha arrived at rank 12 with 1.7%, which is a very mysterious way to show up.
NVIDIA's nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-20261015 set a fresh all-time record at 0.6%, a first-day streak.
Four models fell off the board, including google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813, last seen ranked 51st.
